task.title: P6-171: Promote the struct-update trap into the vendor-component skill
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 9 — Dev loop, tests and test strength). Original id: P6-171. Size: S. Specs: specs/ui-components.md, specs/ui-work-loop.md.

**Promote the `{..}` struct-update trap into the `vendor-component` skill** (was `P6-040a`). A component prop ending in a bare path immediately before `{..}` parses as struct-update syntax (`E0797` plus a bogus "no field on PropsBuilder"); documented only in a `cards.rs` comment and now **rediscovered four times** (`cards.rs`, `catalog.rs`, `query_bar.rs`, `selection_tray.rs`). The skill has no such trap today.
